tours/tour-sri-lanka-highlights.title: Sri Lanka Highlights: 8-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-sri-lanka-highlights.description: The essentials of Sri Lanka in a week, at a relaxed pace with two nights at every stop: the Sigiriya rock fortress and wild elephants, sacred Kandy and its tea hills, and colonial Galle on the south coast.

tours/tour-classic-ceylon-coast.title: Classic Ceylon & Coast: 14-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-classic-ceylon-coast.description: The complete first visit at an easy pace: three nights among the ancient cities, sacred Kandy, two nights in tea country, the mountain village of Ella and three days on a palm-fringed beach to finish.

tours/tour-untamed-sri-lanka.title: Untamed Sri Lanka: Cloud Forests, Leopards & Whales: 12-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-untamed-sri-lanka.description: Three national parks, the cloud forest of Horton Plains and the ocean: a journey built around Sri Lanka's wildlife, always watched responsibly, and with two nights at almost every stop.

tours/tour-summer-family-adventure.title: Summer Family Adventure: 15-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-summer-family-adventure.description: Temples, tea hills, wild elephants, surf lessons and calm east-coast beaches, timed for the UK school holidays when Sri Lanka's east coast is at its best. Short drives and plenty of downtime keep everyone happy.

tours/tour-footprints-northern-frontiers.title: Footprints in the Hills & Northern Frontiers: 15-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-footprints-northern-frontiers.description: Go beyond the classic route: the ancient city of Anuradhapura, the Tamil culture of Jaffna and Trincomalee's beaches, then the Cultural Triangle and Kandy, finishing with three slow nights walking the Pekoe Trail from a planter's bungalow.

tours/tour-honeymoon-tea-hills-beaches.title: Honeymoon: Tea Hills & Southern Beaches: 11-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-honeymoon-tea-hills-beaches.description: A romantic journey of boutique stays: a jungle lodge near Sigiriya, a private tea planter's bungalow in the hills, and three slow days in a beach villa on the quiet south coast.

tours/tour-ayurveda-wellness.title: Ayurveda & Wellness Retreat: 10-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-ayurveda-wellness.description: Slow down in the hills of Kandy and a quiet tea estate, then spend five nights at an Ayurveda resort on the coast, with daily treatments, yoga and healthy food guided by an Ayurvedic doctor.

tours/tour-east-coast-summer.title: East Coast Summer Escape: 11-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-east-coast-summer.description: When the monsoon brings rain to the south-west, the east coast enjoys calm seas and sunshine. Combine the ancient sites of the Cultural Triangle with six nights on the beaches of Trincomalee and Pasikuda.

tours/tour-tea-trails-pekoe-walking.title: Tea Trails & Pekoe Trail Walking: 10-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-tea-trails-pekoe-walking.description: Walk Sri Lanka's long-distance Pekoe Trail through tea estates, villages and forest, staying in a colonial tea bungalow. Your car carries the luggage, so you walk with just a day pack.

tours/tour-grand-explorer.title: Grand Explorer: 16-Day Private Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/tour-grand-explorer.description: The complete island journey: the ancient cities of Anuradhapura and Polonnaruwa, Sigiriya, Kandy, a tea planter's bungalow, Ella, leopards in Yala and the colonial charm of Galle, all at a comfortable pace.

tours/day-tour-colombo-city.title: Colombo City & Culture: Private Day Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/day-tour-colombo-city.description: Colombo's temples, markets and colonial streets in an easy half day: Gangaramaya Temple, Pettah market by tuk-tuk, the Old Dutch Hospital and sunset at Galle Face Green.

tours/day-tour-kandy-temple-tooth.title: Kandy & the Temple of the Tooth: Private Day Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/day-tour-kandy-temple-tooth.description: A full day from Colombo or Negombo to Sri Lanka's hill capital, with a spice garden on the way, the Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic, Kandy Lake and the Royal Botanical Gardens at Peradeniya.

tours/day-tour-sigiriya-dambulla.title: Sigiriya & Dambulla: Private Day Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/day-tour-sigiriya-dambulla.description: A long, early-starting day from Colombo or Negombo: climb Sigiriya Rock, share a village lunch, then visit the Dambulla cave temple.

tours/day-tour-galle-fort-walk.title: Galle Fort Walking Tour: Private Day Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/day-tour-galle-fort-walk.description: A half-day walk from Galle, Unawatuna or Mirissa around the UNESCO-listed fort: the ramparts, lighthouse, Dutch church, boutiques and cafés, finishing with sunset on the walls.

tours/day-tour-udawalawe-safari.title: Udawalawe Elephant Safari: Private Day Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/day-tour-udawalawe-safari.description: A full day from Mirissa or Galle: feeding time at the Elephant Transit Home, then an afternoon jeep safari among the wild herds of Udawalawe.

tours/day-tour-mirissa-whales.title: Whale Watching from Mirissa: Private Day Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/day-tour-mirissa-whales.description: An early-morning boat with a responsible operator in search of blue whales, with breakfast on board and the afternoon free on the beach. Runs December to April only.

tours/day-tour-madu-ganga-turtles.title: Madu Ganga River & Turtle Conservation: Private Day Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/day-tour-madu-ganga-turtles.description: A half day from Bentota: a boat through the mangroves of the Madu Ganga to a cinnamon island, then a visit to a turtle conservation project. Runs all year.

tours/day-tour-minneriya-kaudulla-safari.title: Minneriya or Kaudulla Elephant Safari: Private Day Tour | Zeilan Paradise
tours/day-tour-minneriya-kaudulla-safari.description: An afternoon jeep safari from Sigiriya, Habarana or Kandy. Your guide picks the park where the elephant herds are gathering; the great gathering peaks from July to October.

journal/best-time-to-visit-sri-lanka.title: The best time to visit Sri Lanka, month by month | Zeilan Paradise
journal/best-time-to-visit-sri-lanka.description: Two monsoons, two coasts, one simple rule: there is always somewhere wonderful to be. Here is how to choose.

journal/two-weeks-in-sri-lanka.title: Two weeks in Sri Lanka: a perfect first route | Zeilan Paradise
journal/two-weeks-in-sri-lanka.description: Ancient cities, tea country, leopards and the sea, in one unhurried loop with no backtracking.

journal/sri-lanka-travel-tips-uk.title: Before you go: Sri Lanka tips for UK travellers | Zeilan Paradise
journal/sri-lanka-travel-tips-uk.description: Flights, money, plugs, temple etiquette and the small things that make a big difference.

journal/ten-days-in-sri-lanka.title: 10 days in Sri Lanka: an easy first route | Zeilan Paradise
journal/ten-days-in-sri-lanka.description: Sigiriya, Kandy, tea country, Ella and the south coast in ten unhurried days, with the drives kept short.

journal/sri-lanka-with-children.title: Sri Lanka with children: a family guide | Zeilan Paradise
journal/sri-lanka-with-children.description: Elephants, beaches, trains and tuk-tuks: how to plan a relaxed Sri Lanka holiday the whole family will love.
